display.purpose: Landing thesis and active tool names; compressed line-height creates the dense two-line silhouette.

command.purpose: Open and export actions paired with the amber command prefix.

label.purpose: File facts, field names, privacy proof, status, and numeric readouts.

shadows.name: popover-lift
shadows.purpose: Structural elevation for the settings menu over the workspace.

shadows.name: media-lift
shadows.purpose: Low ambient shadow beneath the crop canvas.

motion.name: dust-drift
motion.purpose: Moves only the masked atmospheric dust behind the active plane.

motion.name: command-shift
motion.purpose: Moves the open-file plane 14px toward the pointer during a drag.

motion.name: cursor-blink

components.name: Open File Command
components.description: The unboxed front-plane action used to choose or receive a local file.
components.css: .ds-open-command { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); background: transparent; font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 220ms ease-out, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-open-command > span:first-child { color: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-open-command i { width: 0.16em; height: 0.72em; background: var(--signal, #ffb000); animation: ds-cursor-blink 1.1s steps(2, jump-none) infinite; } .ds-open-command:hover { filter: brightness(1.28); transform: translateX(14px); } .ds-open-command:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-open-command:active { transform: translateX(10px); } @keyframes ds-cursor-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Export Command
components.description: The completing action, compact in the desktop rail and repeated beneath the mobile preview.
components.css: .ds-export-command { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); background: transparent; font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-export-command > span:first-child { color: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-export-command i { width: 0.16em; height: 0.72em; background: var(--signal, #ffb000); animation: ds-export-blink 1.1s steps(2, jump-none) infinite; } .ds-export-command:hover { filter: brightness(1.2); } .ds-export-command:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-export-command:active { transform: translateX(4px); } @keyframes ds-export-blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Tool Navigation
components.description: A depth-ranked horizontal queue with one amber-prefixed active operation.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tool-nav" aria-label="File tools"><button class="ds-active" type="button">crop</button><button type="button">resize</button><button type="button">trim</button><button type="button">convert</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tool-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(18px, 4vw, 64px); overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'VT323', monospace; } .ds-tool-nav button { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--dust, #77756e); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; transition: color 180ms ease-out, letter-spacing 180ms ease-out; } .ds-tool-nav button:hover, .ds-tool-nav button.ds-active { color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-tool-nav button.ds-active::before { content: '> '; color: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-tool-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-tool-nav button:active { color: var(--signal, #ffb000); }

components.name: Option Line
components.description: Unboxed aspect or mode choices selected by a single amber underline.
components.css: .ds-option-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px 18px; font-family: 'VT323', monospace; } .ds-option-line button { padding: 6px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; color: var(--dust, #77756e); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.15rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option-line button:hover, .ds-option-line button.ds-active { border-color: var(--signal, #ffb000); color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); } .ds-option-line button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-option-line button:active { color: var(--signal, #ffb000); }

components.name: Underline Number Field
components.description: A transparent numeric control cut into the plane with one dust underline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--frost, #aaa79f); font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dust, #77756e); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.35rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--frost, #aaa79f); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Settings Popover
components.description: The single structurally elevated utility surface for persistent preferences.
components.css: .ds-settings { display: grid; gap: 20px; width: min(320px, calc(100vw - 30px)); padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--dust, #77756e); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); background: var(--void, #000000); box-shadow: 10px 14px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34); font-family: 'VT323', monospace; } .ds-settings label { display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-settings label > span { color: var(--frost, #aaa79f); font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-settings select { min-height: 38px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--dust, #77756e); border-radius: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; font: inherit; font-size: 1.35rem; } .ds-settings select:hover, .ds-settings select:focus { border-color: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-settings select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Local Processing Mark
components.description: A compact privacy proof led by the same square amber signal used for active work.
components.css: .ds-local-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--dust, #77756e); font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: 1.08rem; letter-spacing: 0.055em; } .ds-local-mark::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--signal, #ffb000); } .ds-local-mark:hover { color: var(--frost, #aaa79f); }

components.name: File Fact Line
components.description: The low-contrast metadata baseline that keeps the current file and its local status visible.
components.html: portrait.webp2.4 MB1920 × 1080local only
components.css: .ds-file-line { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto auto; align-items: center; gap: clamp(18px, 4vw, 56px); min-height: 42px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(230, 226, 214, 0.25)); color: var(--dust, #77756e); font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: 1.08rem; letter-spacing: 0.055em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-file-line button { padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--signal, #ffb000); background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-file-line button:hover { color: var(--focus, #ffd166); } .ds-file-line button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #ffd166); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-file-name { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ivory, #e6e2d6); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-local::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 10px; background: var(--signal, #ffb000); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-file-line { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px 14px; padding-block: 8px 14px; } .ds-file-name { grid-column: 2; } .ds-file-line > span:not(.ds-file-name) { grid-column: 2; } }

narrative.overview:
Concise is a still, bright working plane suspended over an emissive black field. The selected file and operation stay visually fixed while inactive utilities recede through lower luminance, wider spacing, quieter type, and a slow dust field. The result should feel like local digital work with a pulse, not a themed retro interface.

The system refuses the boxed upload-dashboard convention. Structure comes from baselines, type scale, underlines, and depth-ranked content instead of rounded cards or decorative enclosure. Its light theme is the same world in paper-white negative: semantic roles swap values, but the single amber signal, bitmap voice, and hard geometry remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: One front plane is bright and still; subordinate tools step back through ash values and spatial depth.
Ivory bitmap type carries both identity and utility, with tabular figures for file facts and coordinates.
Amber is a scarce signal for the current path, local-only proof, crop handles, and completion.
Controls are exposed in the workspace rather than wrapped in dashboard cards.
Motion is slow in the atmosphere and quick, short, and directional in interaction states.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber identifies action, focus, locality, progress, or success. Do not turn it into ambient decoration or a second background color.

rules.name: The Semantic Mirror Rule
rules.body: Dark and light modes must preserve role contrast and hierarchy, not merely invert the page.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Keep VT323 across every role. Create hierarchy by size, brightness, measure, and tracking rather than introducing a conventional sans-serif companion.

rules.name: The Brightness Is Weight Rule
rules.body: The implementation has one font weight. Active hierarchy comes from ivory against ash, not synthetic bold.

rules.name: The Front Plane Rule
rules.body: The file, its consequences, and the next completing action occupy the brightest and most stable region; everything else may move or recede around them.

rules.name: The Short Path Rule
rules.body: Responsive rearrangement may wrap metadata or controls, but it must not push the primary export action behind the full mobile control sequence.

rules.name: The Depth Before Boxes Rule
rules.body: First separate hierarchy with luminance, measure, spacing, and receding position. Add an enclosure only when an element truly overlays or bounds interactive media.

rules.name: The Still Foreground Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric motion belongs behind the task. The active file and controls do not drift.

rules.name: The No Decorative Enclosure Rule
rules.body: Do not add dashed upload borders, rounded cards, pills, capsules, or soft containers around actions that can live directly on the plane.

dos: Do preserve one unmistakably bright working plane and push subordinate tools back through the ash ladder.
Do use amber sparingly for the active path, local-processing proof, manipulation handles, progress, and successful completion.
Do keep actions as direct text commands with visible keyboard focus and unambiguous active states.
Do keep export adjacent to the preview on small screens and in the control rail on wider screens.
Do preserve theme parity, tabular figures, reduced-motion handling, and the horizontal mobile tool queue.
donts: Don't introduce rounded cards, pills, gradients, glass effects, or a dashed upload box.
Don't use shadows to manufacture hierarchy that brightness, spacing, and depth ranking already express.
Don't add a second accent or spread amber across decorative surfaces.
Don't replace the bitmap face with a generic product sans-serif or simulate hierarchy with multiple weights.
Don't animate the active file plane; atmosphere can drift, but work stays still.
